Definition: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
BiblicalUsage: Mizmor is the word in the heading of fifty-seven psalms — 'a psalm', a song set to music. It never appears in the body of a psalm at all; it stands at the door, telling the reader this is a song to be sung, not only read.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the headings matter: God gave His people songs, not just sayings, and singing them is part of how the truth gets into the heart.
